title: A Comparative Analysis of Text-to-Image Generative AI Models in Scientific Contexts: A Case Study on Nuclear Power

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with an occupational description ('Person who works in the nuclear industry') and visually analyzing the gender of the generated figures to observe the reproduction of male-dominated occupational stereotypes.

Analyzing the apparent race of figures generated from occupational prompts (noting predominantly Caucasian outputs) and evaluating the models' ability to accurately represent Indigenous and Navajo peoples, tools, and landscapes in response to prompts about the impacts of uranium mining.
